name: search_datasets
description: Search the opendata.swiss catalogue (CKAN package_search). Returns matching Swiss federal/cantonal datasets. Titles/descriptions are multilingual {de,fr,it,en}; each result is annotated with English-preferred `title_en`/`notes_en`.

name: dataset_details
description: Full metadata for one dataset (CKAN package_show) including its resources/distributions with download URLs. Use a dataset `name` (slug) or id from search_datasets. There is no datastore, so fetch `resources[].download_url`/`url` for the underlying data.

name: list_organizations
description: List publishing organizations (federal offices, cantons, etc.). Multilingual titles flattened to `title_en`. Use a returned `name` as `organization:<name>` in search_datasets `fq`.

name: list_groups
description: List thematic categories (CKAN groups / themes, e.g. health, education, energy). Multilingual titles flattened to `title_en`. Use a returned `name` as `groups:<name>` in search_datasets `fq`.

name: list_tags
description: List or search keyword tags used across the catalogue (CKAN tag_list). Useful for discovering facet values.
